source.note: Not AFM/AIC data - practical flight-safety and data-source settings (rekenlogica.md sections 5c and 9), not certification requirements. Always user-adjustable, never hardcoded in Kotlin.

stale_after_minutes_note: Warning (non-blocking) shown once a fetched METAR is older than this. The pilot always checks the weather regardless of age (rekenlogica.md section 5) - this only controls whether an extra staleness warning is shown.
fetch_url_template_note: Online lookup endpoint. {stations} is replaced by a comma-separated list of ICAO station codes. aviationweather.gov is free and needs no account or API key. Blank this string to disable online lookup entirely - the app then keeps whatever was last fetched, and the pilot enters wind/temperature/pressure by hand on the calculation screen.
auto_refresh_after_minutes_note: How old a stored METAR may be before the app fetches a fresh one on its own. Lower than stale_after_minutes on purpose: refreshing earlier than you warn is sensible, and observations are typically reissued every 30 minutes.
